(24 December 2011) |biggest away win = 2 goals (4 times) |highest scoring = [[USM Alger]] 3–4 [[JSM Béjaïa]] |matches = 224 |total goals = 511 |longest wins = [[CA Batna]] (5 games) |title = |longest unbeaten = [[CA Batna]] (7 games) |longest losses = [[NA Hussein Dey]] (4 games) |prevseason = [[2010–11 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 1|2010–11]] |nextseason = [[2012–13 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 1|2012–13]] }} The '''2011–12 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 1''' was the 50th season of the [[Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 1]] since its establishment in 1962. A total of 16 teams contested the league, with [[ASO Chlef]] as the defending champions. The league started on 6 September 2011, and ended on 22 May 2012.{{Cite web |url=http://www.dzfoot.com/news-9489/ligue-1-le-calendrier-complet-de-la-saison-prochaine/ |title=Ligue 1 : Le calendrier complet de la saison prochaine |access-date=13 July 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110716222116/http://www.dzfoot.com/news-9489/ligue-1-le-calendrier-complet-de-la-saison-prochaine/ |archive-date=16 July 2011 |url-status=dead |df=dmy-all }} While the league was originally scheduled to start on 10 September 2011, the official start date will be 6 September 2011, with a match between [[JS Kabylie]] and [[MC Alger]]. The tie was moved up due to the two club's participation in African competition.{{Cite web |url=http://www.lnf.dz/article.php?titre=1601&lang=0 |title=Le programme des matches du mois de septembre |access-date=27 August 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120320213046/http://www.lnf.dz/article.php?titre=1601&lang=0 |archive-date=20 March 2012 |url-status=dead }} ==Team summaries== === Promotion and relegation === '''Teams promoted from [[2010–11 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 2]]'''{{Cite web |url=http://www.dzfoot.com/article-2077.php |title=Ligue 2, 30e j. : Le CSC reçoit son trophée, le PAC sauvé |access-date=9 July 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110722052054/http://www.dzfoot.com/article-2077.php |archive-date=22 July 2011 |url-status=dead |df=dmy-all }} * [[CS Constantine]] * [[NA Hussein Dey]] * [[CA Batna]] '''Teams relegated to [[2011-12 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 2]]'''{{Cite web |url=http://www.dzfoot.com/news-9466/ligue-1-annaba-releguee-jsmb-en-champ-league/ |title=Ligue 1 : Annaba reléguée, JSMB en Champ.
